stepTitle: Holding all other variables constant, how many more sols would a mission last for each additional astronaut in the crew, according to this model? (in additional sols)
stepBody: Yuerou stores features in the design matrix $$X', $$ whose first column is the intercept, second column is the number of food portions, and third column is the number of astronauts. $$Y'$$ stores the mission durations in sols. The ideal weight vector is $$\hat{\theta}=[-3,0.25,2]**T.$$
